summary: A fresh native rebuild reproduced the original N=16 failure at the recorded base. A separate rebuild of exact candidate 6fdbee617e969a0f65c788f41934ffbd15392b90 copied N=16 and independent positive sizes through N=4097 exactly, including the prior N=513 and N=1024 counterexamples. This is a full native-path fix, not test-only hardening.

Candidate regression could not collect because the prepared ROCm source tree has no architecture-specific or fallback common_ops shared library. This is an environment/package limitation, not evidence for or against behavior. Raw log: /job/review-evidence-j-539eef7324e8/candidate-regression-pytest.log

gpu_execution_evidence: Base and candidate native extensions executed on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-; candidate outputs were compared exactly to independently generated CPU int32 tensors.
native_rebuild_evidence: PyTorch HIP translation reported zero unsupported CUDA calls and two candidate kernel-launch translations; /opt/rocm-7.2.4/bin/hipcc compiled candidate copy.cu with --offload-arch=gfx950. The extension was loaded directly, not through the installed wheel.
remaining_limitations: The original GLM-5.2 weights and two-node TP16/EP16 DeepEP deployment were unavailable, so full serving was not reproduced.
Only one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU with ROCm 7.2 was assigned; NVIDIA H800/CUDA compilation and execution remain unverified.
The prepared checkout lacks a built common_ops package, so the candidate's repository pytest could not collect; direct rebuilt-native testing covered its cases and broader adversarial cases.
The review verifies the native transfer contract and production caller shape, not distributed routing or model semantic accuracy.
